definitions.explanation: A category of people sharing certain physical characteristics or ancestry.

examples.japanese: {人種|じんしゅ}{差別|さべつ}は{許|ゆる}されない。
アメリカは{様々|さまざま}な{人種|じんしゅ}の{人|ひと}が{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: People of various races live in America.

examples.japanese: {人種|じんしゅ}に{関係|かんけい}なく{平等|びょうどう}に{扱|あつか}われるべきだ。
examples.english: People should be treated equally regardless of race.

notes:
{人種|じんしゅ} refers to racial or ethnic categories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人種|じんしゅ}{差別|さべつ} (racial discrimination)
- {人種|じんしゅ}{問題|もんだい} (racial issues)
- {人種|じんしゅ}の{壁|かべ} (racial barrier)
- {混血|こんけつ}{人種|じんしゅ} (mixed race)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人種|じんしゅ}: race (physical/biological classification)
- {民族|みんぞく}: ethnic group, people (cultural identity)
- {国籍|こくせき}: nationality (legal citizenship)
